name: NusaTranslation — Indonesian local languages (nusa_kalimat test)
description: NusaTranslation — the held-out test split of the nusa_kalimat MT track of the NusaWrites benchmark: Indonesian ↔ 10 local languages (Ambonese Malay, Betawi, Bima, Javanese, Madurese, Makasar, Minangkabau, Musi, Rejang, Sundanese), human-translated everyday/social-media sentences; both directions scored. Batak ('btk') is excluded — ambiguous ISO 639-5 collective code, never mislabelled. Fetched on demand from the IndoNLP nusa-writes repo at a pinned commit; Champollion never hosts the content. Domain: conv. Contamination HIGH — public since 2023 — so scores are relative-comparison-only. License: repo code is Apache-2.0 but NO data license is stated upstream → held by the license review of 2026-08-24: an unstated data license is never interpreted on the rights-holder's behalf — catalogued, excluded from queue/contests/ranking, until upstream states data terms.

segments.name: NusaTranslation nusa_kalimat test

download.instructions: Per-language single file data/nusa_kalimat-mt-{lang}-test.csv fetched from the pinned commit (immutable); pairing.mode csv-columns pairs the ind_text and tgt_text columns of the same row. Both directions are scored.

source.citation: Cahyawijaya et al. (2023). NusaWrites: Constructing High-Quality Corpora for Underrepresented and Extremely Low-Resource Languages. AACL-IJCNLP 2023.

license.aiTraining: Held-out benchmark test split; not licensed for training. doNotTrain protects benchmark integrity.
license.notes: Verified at the pinned commit: the repo LICENSE (Apache-2.0) covers the code; NO license is stated for the DATA (no data license file, no README license section). Tagged commercial=false / redistribution=false so it stays out of every prize, commercial, and API lane until the founder review clarifies with upstream. Champollion never hosts the content — it is fetched from the pinned upstream commit on demand.

usageRestrictions.communityNotes: Held-out benchmark: training on it defeats its purpose. contamination.reasoning: NusaTranslation (NusaWrites) test split — public since 2023 and in frontier-model training crawls. Scores are valid only for relative method-vs-method comparison on this exact corpus, never as absolute quality. Forced HIGH here and via build_registry.HELD_OUT_BENCHMARK_FAMILIES.

quarantineReason: License review 2026-08-24: HELD. No DATA license is stated at the pinned revision (repo Apache-2.0 covers code only), and an unstated grant is never interpreted on the rights-holder's behalf. Catalogued; excluded from the queue, contests, and ranking (DB trigger, migration 022); remote transmission refused (consent-required). A direct local run stays possible but its result can never rank. Clears when upstream states data terms or the rights-holder records a grant.

excluded.btk: Upstream 'btk' is the ISO 639-5 COLLECTIVE code (Batak languages); which individual Batak variety the data represents (bbc Toba? btx Karo? ...) is not stated at the pinned revision, so no individual-language card can be honestly assigned (never mislabel). Excluded until upstream clarifies.
